subject: SIG submission — consolidated 3P/vendor footprint + telemetry manifest
messages:
From: security@nimbus-analytics.com (N. Singh)
To: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG intake — consolidated 3P list + telemetry mapping request

Hi Marcus / Redwood team,

As part of our SIG review for the upcoming audit window (target submission 2027-04-07), we need a consolidated manifest of all third-party vendors and a telemetry routing mapping that shows where logs/metrics/traces are sent. Specifically we are asking for:

- A CSV export with one row per vendor containing: vendor name, service type (cloud/telemetry/support/infra), data types processed (PII, telemetry, config), contract owner, subprocessors list (if any), country of processing, and last review date.
- Telemetry mapping (spreadsheet) indicating which telemetry categories (metrics, traces, logs, usage events) are sent to which vendor, retention windows, and encryption-in-transit status.
- Any known subprocessor chains (e.g., vendor X uses vendor Y for backups) should be explicitly called out.

Can you confirm ownership and an estimated delivery date? We may follow up with a short evidence request for encryption/TLS configs and contractual clauses.

Thanks,
Nikhil Singh
Head of Vendor Risk
Nimbus Analytics
[security@nimbus-analytics.com]
From: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
To: security@nimbus-analytics.com
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG intake — consolidated 3P list + telemetry mapping request

Thanks Nikhil — we can provide this. Looping in Lauren (Vendor Ops) and Neha (Security Ops) to pull the export and telemetry map.

Proposed plan:
- Lauren to produce the CSV vendor manifest and initial telemetry_map spreadsheet by EOD Fri (2027-04-02).
- Neha to prepare short evidence snippets for any high-risk telemetry recipients (encryption in transit, retention policy screenshots) by Mon (2027-04-05).
- I'll compile and provide a cover attestation and a signed PDF for SIG consumption by Tue (2027-04-06).

Couple of clarifying Qs from our side:
- For telemetry mapping, do you need per-topic retention (e.g., auth logs = 90 days, usage events = 365 days) or just vendor-level retention?
- Will a single consolidated CSV be acceptable or do you prefer separate exports per product area?

We can also flag any vendors under legal review (redlines pending) so you can treat them as 'in-flight'.

Marcus Lin
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Key highlights from the CSV (first 25 lines):

- Cloud: GCP (BigQuery) — analytics storage for de-identified telemetry; contract owner: Analytics (Maya).

- Telemetry: Sentry — error events (no PII); retention: 30 days; uses TLS.
- Support: Zendesk — customer support tickets; processes PII; retention per contract; legal redline flag present.

Open items (call-outs in redline_summary.docx):
- Zendesk contract has a pending data processing amendment (legal).
- Segment configuration: we send a subset of anonymized usage events; full event payloads are not forwarded to downstream analytics without masking. Need Security to attest to masking approach.
